what: Tapping the + at the card corner makes the front (number group) vanish and push away, and the back (testimonial) rises in from 24px below. The + turns 45° into an × and the card background changes to --fx-flip-bg. Tap again to reverse. Framer spring .4s (damping .8)

options.--fx-flip-bg: Flipped card background (css variable, unchanged if absent)
options.--fx-front-shift: Direction the front face drops away (css variable, default up 24px — deserve is down 113px)

note: The original swaps a Framer variant — the number group moves 113px down to the bottom center and fades out, the card background goes ink → dark ink-green, and the + rotates 45° in 150ms. The measured curve is a spring (css linear() 400ms)
